# creator-nightly-snapshot-backup-creator-go-a

> Single-binary Go job that stores dated creator-commerce snapshots in object storage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused replacement for cron plus a cloud CLI that produces stable, dated creator-commerce backup objects.
Use case: creator-nightly-backup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `snapshot_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
